rationale: With only 22 minutes to close, the last five 1-minute candles show a tight, choppy range ($11.65–$11.71) with no clear directional momentum — price is drifting slightly lower from the 9-EMA ($11.70) but without conviction. The stock gapped down 13.5% on severely negative earnings expectations and has already recovered significantly from the session low ($10.68) to 77% of the day's range, making a late-day continuation in either direction uncertain. The risk/reward does not justify entering a new position this close to forced liquidation at the close.
